notes.title: Get your own Klonoa Costume Set!
notes.notes:
[h3]We are pleased to announce that the Klonoa Costume Set has been released freely for all users. Players will be able to change into outfits featured in the original games: "Klonoa: Door to Phantomile" and "Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42476337/2b5dcfe9c937c0af7bf4dc0e84182f2cd93c82c0.png[/img]
*Players can change outfits in the Costume section in the Options menu.
In order to use this content, please update the game to the newest version.

Thank you for your continuous support to KLONOA Phantasy Reverie Series.
[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730680/Klonoa_Phantasy_Reverie_Series/

notes.title: Happy 25th anniversary! 🥳
notes.notes:
[h2]Yesterday, December 11 was the date when [b][i]Kaze no Klonoa Door to Phantomile[/i][/b] was released 25 years ago! 🎂

To commemorate the 25th anniversary of Klonoa, enjoy this new illustration from Character Designer Yoshihiko Arai!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42476337/1417973ca56c68cf1b56dc68b53bbe64aee25583.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42476337/5a8644ba66cc8c1110327e6550e4fea3accc2c33.jpg[/img]

We would like to thank all fans for your continuous support![/h2]

notes.title: KLONOA Phantasy Reverie Series is available now!
notes.notes:
[h3]Celebrating the [b]25th anniversary of the Klonoa franchise[/b], the ✨vibrant and joyful✨ side-scrolling platform game is back with a graphic revamp for a new generation of players to discover and fans of the first hour to revisit! [/h3]

Leaning on the nostalgia and great memories of the series, the trailer brings back the song played in the [i]1991 commercial in Japan.[/i]

[previewyoutube=2In1N25DSWI;full][/previewyoutube]
Klonoa Phantasy Reverie Series features [b]Klonoa: Door to Phantomile[/b] and [b]Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil[/b], with an [u]adjustable difficulty level[/u] and [u]2 players co-op option[/u].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42476337/56cb8f82b48b9920dc5064d506ea5e71ca087dfe.png[/img]
